WITH top_source AS (
  SELECT trafficSource.source
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source
  ORDER BY SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1000000.0 as monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month, trafficSource.source
)
SELECT 
  m.source as traffic_source,
  ROUND(MAX(m.monthly_revenue_millions) - MIN(m.monthly_revenue_millions), 2) as monthly_diff_millions
FROM monthly m
JOIN top_source ts ON m.source = ts.source
GROUP BY m.source

WITH traffic_source_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source as traffic_source,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 as total_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) as h,
    UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source
),
top_source AS (
  SELECT traffic_source
  FROM traffic_source_revenue
  ORDER BY total_revenue_millions DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
daily_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.date)) as day,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 as daily_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s,
    UNNEST(s.hits) as h,
    UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE s._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND s.trafficSource.source = (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source)
  GROUP BY s.date
),
weekly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(day, WEEK(MONDAY)) as week_start,
    SUM(daily_rev) as weekly_rev
  FROM daily_revenue
  GROUP BY week_start
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(day, MONTH) as month_start,
    SUM(daily_rev) as monthly_rev
  FROM daily_revenue
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source) as traffic_source,
  (SELECT MAX(daily_rev) FROM daily_revenue) as max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(weekly_rev) FROM weekly_revenue) as max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(monthly_rev) FROM monthly_revenue) as max_monthly_product_revenue_millions

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitorId,
    date,
    visitNumber,
    visitId,
    totals.transactions AS txn_count,
    device.deviceCategory,
    device.isMobile
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date AS first_transaction_date,
    deviceCategory,
    isMobile,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date, visitNumber) AS rn
  FROM sessions
  WHERE txn_count IS NOT NULL AND txn_count > 0
)
SELECT 
  ftv.fullVisitorId
FROM first_visit ftv
JOIN first_transaction ftx ON ftv.fullVisitorId = ftx.fullVisitorId AND ftx.rn = 1
WHERE ftx.first_transaction_date > ftv.first_visit_date
  AND ftx.deviceCategory = 'mobile'
ORDER BY ftv.fullVisitorId

WITH drug_state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    nppes_provider_state AS state,
    drug_name,
    SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claims
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
  WHERE nppes_provider_state NOT IN ('AA','AE','AP','AS','GU','MP','PR','VI')
  GROUP BY nppes_provider_state, drug_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    drug_name,
    total_claims,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY total_claims DESC) AS rn
  FROM drug_state_totals
)
SELECT state, drug_name, total_claims
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY state

SELECT 
  state,
  COUNT(*) as total_events
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1980' AND '1995'
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH wa_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'WA'
),
rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    g.stn,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN wa_stations ws ON g.stn = ws.usaf
  WHERE g.prcp > 0 AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY g.stn
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 150
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT 
    g.stn,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` g
  JOIN wa_stations ws ON g.stn = ws.usaf
  WHERE g.prcp > 0 AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY g.stn
)
SELECT 
  ws.usaf AS station_id,
  MIN(ws.name) AS station_name,
  r2023.rainy_days_2023,
  r2022.rainy_days_2022
FROM rainy_2023 r2023
JOIN rainy_2022 r2022 ON r2023.stn = r2022.stn
JOIN wa_stations ws ON r2023.stn = ws.usaf
WHERE r2023.rainy_days_2023 < r2022.rainy_days_2022
GROUP BY ws.usaf, r2023.rainy_days_2023, r2022.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY r2023.rainy_days_2023 DESC

WITH station_prcp AS (
  SELECT date, value/10 as prcp_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025' 
    AND element = 'PRCP' 
    AND qflag IS NULL 
    AND mflag IS NULL
),
weather AS (
  SELECT date,
    CASE WHEN prcp_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END as weather_condition
  FROM station_prcp
),
bike_daily AS (
  SELECT DATE(starttime) as trip_date, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
)
SELECT w.weather_condition,
  ROUND(AVG(b.trip_count), 2) as avg_daily_trips
FROM weather w
JOIN bike_daily b ON w.date = b.trip_date
GROUP BY w.weather_condition
ORDER BY w.weather_condition

-- Full solution with station_id as primary key
WITH round_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    end_station_id,
    end_station_name,
    starttime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
trip_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    r1.start_station_id,
    r1.start_station_name,
    r1.end_station_id,
    r1.end_station_name,
    r1.starttime,
    COUNT(*) as nearby_trips
  FROM round_trips r1
  JOIN round_trips r2 
    ON r1.start_station_id = r2.start_station_id
    AND ABS(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(r1.starttime, r2.starttime, MINUTE)) <= 2
  GROUP BY r1.start_station_id, r1.start_station_name, r1.end_station_id, r1.end_station_name, r1.starttime
),
group_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as num_group_trips
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE nearby_trips >= 2
  GROUP BY start_station_id
),
total_trips_per_station AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT 
    station_id,
    name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT start_station_id as station_id, start_station_name as name 
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT end_station_id as station_id, end_station_name as name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  )
  GROUP BY station_id, name
)
SELECT 
  gs.start_station_id,
  sn.name,
  gs.num_group_trips,
  ts.total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(gs.num_group_trips, ts.total_trips) as proportion
FROM group_trips gs
JOIN total_trips_per_station ts 
  ON gs.start_station_id = ts.end_station_id
JOIN station_names sn
  ON gs.start_station_id = sn.station_id AND sn.rn = 1
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Final verification: get the top 20 Citi Bike routes by trip count in 2016,
-- find those faster than yellow taxis (by matching rounded coordinates to 3 decimals),
-- and return the one with the longest average bike duration.

WITH route_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        start_station_latitude,
        start_station_longitude,
        end_station_latitude,
        end_station_longitude,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, 
             start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude,
             end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE trip_distance > 0
        AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3), ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3),
             ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3)
)
SELECT 
    rs.start_station_name,
    rs.end_station_name,
    ROUND(rs.avg_bike_duration, 3) as avg_bike_duration
FROM route_stats rs
LEFT JOIN taxi_averages ta 
    ON ROUND(rs.start_station_latitude, 3) = ta.start_lat 
    AND ROUND(rs.start_station_longitude, 3) = ta.start_lon
    AND ROUND(rs.end_station_latitude, 3) = ta.end_lat
    AND ROUND(rs.end_station_longitude, 3) = ta.end_lon
WHERE ta.avg_taxi_duration IS NOT NULL 
    AND rs.avg_bike_duration < ta.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY rs.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.dropoff_datetime,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    t.pickup_location_id,
    tz.borough AS pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
),
with_tip_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount)
    END as tip_rate
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 1 END) as no_tip_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 1 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as no_tip_percentage
FROM with_tip_rate
GROUP BY pickup_borough
ORDER BY pickup_borough

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
ada_entry_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    s.borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) AS stations_with_ada_entry
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` se
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
    ON se.station_name = s.station_name
    AND se.station_lat = s.station_lat
    AND se.station_lon = s.station_lon
  WHERE se.entry = TRUE
    AND se.ada_compliant = TRUE
  GROUP BY s.borough_name
)
SELECT 
  sc.borough_name,
  sc.total_stations,
  COALESCE(aec.stations_with_ada_entry, 0) AS stations_with_ada_entry,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(aec.stations_with_ada_entry, 0), sc.total_stations) * 100 AS percentage
FROM station_counts sc
LEFT JOIN ada_entry_counts aec
  ON sc.borough_name = aec.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_id,
    start_date,
    duration_sec / 60.0 AS duration_min,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date ASC) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS first_trip_duration_min,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS last_trip_duration_min,
  MAX(duration_min) AS highest_trip_duration_min,
  MIN(duration_min) AS lowest_trip_duration_min
FROM ranked
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month

WITH trips_with_region AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trip_id,
    t.duration_sec,
    t.start_date,
    t.start_station_name,
    t.member_gender,
    s.region_id,
    r.name AS region_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.region_id ORDER BY t.start_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON t.start_station_id = CAST(s.station_id AS INT64)
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r
    ON s.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_date) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2017
)
SELECT 
  region_name,
  trip_id,
  duration_sec,
  start_date,
  start_station_name,
  member_gender
FROM trips_with_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_name;

-- Full query: neighborhoods with at least 1 bike station and at least 1 crime incident
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood,
         COUNT(DISTINCT bs.station_id) as bike_station_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` bs
    ON ST_WITHIN(bs.station_geom, b.neighborhood_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
),
crime_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood,
         COUNT(DISTINCT si.unique_key) as crime_incident_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` si
    ON ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(si.longitude, si.latitude), b.neighborhood_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT sc.neighborhood,
       sc.bike_station_count,
       cc.crime_incident_count
FROM station_counts sc
JOIN crime_counts cc ON sc.neighborhood = cc.neighborhood
ORDER BY sc.neighborhood

SELECT 
    country_name,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` 
WHERE date = '2020-05-10' 
  AND aggregation_level = 0 
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT (CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT facility_place_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_vaccination_access.facility_boundary_us_all` WHERE facility_sub_region_1 = 'California') AS FLOAT64) / (SELECT SUM(total_pop) FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%')) * 1000 as vaccine_sites_per_1000_people

SELECT 
  b.country_name,
  b.net_migration
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.birth_death_growth_rates` b
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.country_names_area` a
  ON b.country_code = a.country_code
WHERE b.year = 2017
  AND a.country_area > 500
ORDER BY b.net_migration DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH tournament_games AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    'win' AS label,
    win_seed AS seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    lose_seed AS opponent_seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    season,
    'loss' AS label,
    lose_seed AS seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    win_seed AS opponent_seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    season,
    label,
    seed,
    school_ncaa,
    opponent_seed,
    opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.2018_tournament_results`
)
SELECT 
  tg.season,
  tg.label,
  tg.seed,
  tg.school_ncaa,
  tg.opponent_seed,
  tg.opponent_school_ncaa,
  fe.pace_rank,
  fe.poss_40min,
  fe.pace_rating,
  fe.efficiency_rank,
  fe.pts_100poss,
  fe.efficiency_rating,
  fe_opp.pace_rank AS opp_pace_rank,
  fe_opp.poss_40min AS opp_poss_40min,
  fe_opp.pace_rating AS opp_pace_rating,
  fe_opp.efficiency_rank AS opp_efficiency_rank,
  fe_opp.pts_100poss AS opp_pts_100poss,
  fe_opp.efficiency_rating AS opp_efficiency_rating,
  fe_opp.pace_rank - fe.pace_rank AS pace_rank_diff,
  fe_opp.poss_40min - fe.poss_40min AS pace_stat_diff,
  fe_opp.pace_rating - fe.pace_rating AS pace_rating_diff,
  fe_opp.efficiency_rank - fe.efficiency_rank AS eff_rank_diff,
  fe_opp.pts_100poss - fe.pts_100poss AS eff_stat_diff,
  fe_opp.efficiency_rating - fe.efficiency_rating AS eff_rating_diff
FROM tournament_games tg
LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe 
  ON tg.school_ncaa = fe.team AND tg.season = fe.season
LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe_opp 
  ON tg.opponent_school_ncaa = fe_opp.team AND tg.season = fe_opp.season

WITH base AS (
  SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall' AND report_year IN (2014, 2022)
),
y2014 AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian AS v_asian_2014,
    race_black AS v_black_2014,
    race_hispanic_latinx AS v_latinx_2014,
    race_native_american AS v_native_american_2014,
    race_white AS v_white_2014,
    gender_us_women AS v_us_women_2014,
    gender_us_men AS v_us_men_2014,
    gender_global_women AS v_global_women_2014,
    gender_global_men AS v_global_men_2014
  FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014
),
y2022 AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian AS v_asian_2022,
    race_black AS v_black_2022,
    race_hispanic_latinx AS v_latinx_2022,

SELECT 
    a.id AS answer_id,
    u_answer.reputation AS answerer_reputation,
    a.score AS answer_score,
    a.comment_count AS answer_comment_count,
    q.tags AS question_tags,
    q.score AS question_score,
    q.answer_count AS question_answer_count,
    u_asker.reputation AS asker_reputation,
    q.view_count AS question_view_count,
    q.comment_count AS question_comment_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u_answer ON a.owner_user_id = u_answer.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u_asker ON q.owner_user_id = u_asker.id
WHERE a.creation_date >= '2016-01-01' AND a.creation_date < '2016-02-01'
  AND q.creation_date >= '2016-01-01' AND q.creation_date < '2016-02-01'
  AND q.accepted_answer_id = a.id
  AND q.tags LIKE '%javascript%'
  AND (q.tags LIKE '%xss%' OR q.tags LIKE '%cross-site%' OR q.tags LIKE '%exploit%' OR q.tags LIKE '%cybersecurity%')

WITH user_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.id AS answer_id,
    pa.parent_id AS question_id,
    pa.creation_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND pa.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    ua.answer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvote_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_count
  FROM user_answers ua
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` v ON v.post_id = ua.answer_id
  GROUP BY ua.answer_id
),
answer_tags AS (
  SELECT 
    ua.answer_id,
    pq.tags,
    av.upvote_count,
    av.accepted_count
  FROM user_answers ua
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pq.id = ua.question_id
  JOIN answer_votes av ON av.answer_id = ua.answer_id
  WHERE pq.tags IS NOT NULL AND pq.tags != ''
),
tagged_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    answer_id,
    tag,
    upvote_count,
    accepted_count
  FROM answer_tags,
  UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) AS tag
)
SELECT 
  tag,
  SUM(10 * upvote_count + 15 * accepted_count) AS total_score
FROM tagged_votes
GROUP BY tag
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH chr13_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 48481890 AND `End` > 48303751
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 7687490 AND `End` > 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain'
    AND Start < 108369102 AND `End` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  INNER JOIN chr17_loss c17 
    ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  INNER JOIN chr11_gain c11 
    ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
),
chr13_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, 
    MIN(ChrOrd) as chr13_ChOrd, MIN(Start) as chr13_Start, MIN(`End`) as chr13_End
  FROM chr13_loss
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
),
chr17_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
    MIN(ChrOrd) as chr17_ChOrd, MIN(Start) as chr17_Start, MIN(`End`) as chr17_End
  FROM chr17_loss
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
),
chr11_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
    MIN(ChrOrd) as chr11_ChOrd, MIN(Start) as chr11_Start, MIN(`End`) as chr11_End
  FROM chr11_gain
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  mc.RefNo,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo,
  mc.Clone,
  kc.CloneShort,
  c13_agg.chr13_ChOrd,
  c13_agg.chr13_Start,
  c13_agg.chr13_End,
  c17_agg.chr17_ChOrd,
  c17_agg.chr17_Start,
  c17_agg.chr17_End,
  c11_agg.chr11_ChOrd,
  c11_agg.chr11_Start,
  c11_agg.chr11_End
FROM matching_clones mc
INNER JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc
  ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
LEFT JOIN chr13_agg c13_agg
  ON mc.RefNo = c13_agg.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13_agg.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13_agg.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13_agg.Clone
LEFT JOIN chr17_agg c17_agg
  ON mc.RefNo = c17_agg.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17_agg.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17_agg.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17_agg.Clone
LEFT JOIN chr11_agg c11_agg
  ON mc.RefNo = c11_agg.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11_agg.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11_agg.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11_agg.Clone

-- Find the user with the highest first gap month number
-- First gap month number = the first month within their activity span where they had no activity

WITH user_months AS (
  SELECT 
    `by` as user_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE timestamp <= TIMESTAMP('2024-09-10')
    AND `by` IS NOT NULL
    AND `by` != ''
  GROUP BY `by`, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH)
),
user_range AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(activity_month) as first_month,
    MAX(activity_month) as last_month,
    COUNT(*) as actual_months
  FROM user_months
  GROUP BY user_id
),
-- Filter to users with at least one gap
users_with_gaps AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, actual_months,
         (DATE_DIFF(last_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1) as expected_months
  FROM user_range
  WHERE (DATE_DIFF(last_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1) - actual_months > 0
),
-- For each user, find their first gap month number
-- This is expensive, so let's focus on users with many actual months (more likely to have high first gap)
-- First, get the top candidates by actual_months
top_candidates AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, actual_months, expected_months
  FROM users_with_gaps
  ORDER BY actual_months DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
-- Generate all months for each candidate's span and find first gap
all_months AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month,
         GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(first_month, last_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) as month_arr
  FROM top_candidates
),
months_expanded AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, month,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY month) as month_number
  FROM all_months, UNNEST(month_arr) as month
),
-- Join with actual activity to find gaps
first_gaps AS (
  SELECT me.user_id, me.first_month, me.last_month, me.month, me.month_number
  FROM months_expanded me
  LEFT JOIN user_months um ON me.user_id = um.user_id AND me.month = um.activity_month
  WHERE um.activity_month IS NULL
),
-- Get the first gap (minimum month_number) for each user
user_first_gaps AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(month_number) as first_gap_month_number
  FROM first_gaps
  GROUP BY user_id
)
-- Find the user with the highest first gap month number
SELECT ufg.user_id, ufg.first_gap_month_number
FROM user_first_gaps ufg
ORDER BY ufg.first_gap_month_number DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Return exactly 1 row: the Monday date of the cohort with the highest 4th week retention
WITH user_first AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date)) - 2) DAY) as cohort_monday
  FROM user_first
  WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date) >= '2018-07-02'
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_monday,
    COUNT(*) as total_users
  FROM user_cohort
  GROUP BY cohort_monday
),
user_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.cohort_monday,
    uc.user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE 
      WHEN PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) >= DATE_ADD(uc.cohort_monday, INTERVAL 21 DAY)
        AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) <= DATE_ADD(uc.cohort_monday, INTERVAL 27 DAY)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) as returned_week4
  FROM user_cohort uc
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON uc.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY uc.cohort_monday, uc.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  cr.cohort_monday
FROM cohort_sizes cr
LEFT JOIN user_retention ur ON cr.cohort_monday = ur.cohort_monday
GROUP BY cr.cohort_monday, cr.total_users
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(CASE WHEN ur.returned_week4 = 1 THEN 1 END), cr.total_users) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH users_first_engagement AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_engagement_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180815'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    e.user_pseudo_id,
    e.event_timestamp,
    e.event_name as first_quickplay_event
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  JOIN users_first_engagement u 
    ON e.user_pseudo_id = u.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180815'
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_quickplay_event,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn
  FROM user_first_quickplay
),
user_first_qp AS (
  SELECT u1.user_pseudo_id, u1.first_quickplay_event, u2.first_engagement_date
  FROM ranked u1
  JOIN users_first_engagement u2 ON u1.user_pseudo_id = u2.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE u1.rn = 1
),
session_start_check AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_pseudo_id,
    u.first_quickplay_event,
    u.first_engagement_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.event_name = 'session_start' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as had_session_start_week2
  FROM user_first_qp u
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` s
    ON u.user_pseudo_id = s.user_pseudo_id
    AND s.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND s.event_date >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', u.first_engagement_date), INTERVAL 8 DAY))
    AND s.event_date <= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', u.first_engagement_date), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
  GROUP BY u.user_pseudo_id, u.first_quickplay_event, u.first_engagement_date
)
SELECT first_quickplay_event, 
       COUNT(*) as total_users,
       SUM(had_session_start_week2) as retained_users,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(had_session_start_week2), COUNT(*)) as retention_rate
FROM session_start_check
GROUP BY first_quickplay_event
ORDER BY retention_rate ASC
